muskogee.line: But the posse caught up with me and drug me back to Muskogee
stanza: Then, a friend said he knew where some easy money was
We robbed a man, and, brother, did we fly
But the posse caught up with me and drug me back to Muskogee
And it's two long years a-waitin' around to die

muskogee.line: But the posse caught up with me, and he drag me back to Muskogee
stanza: Then a friend said he knew, where some easy money was
We robbed a man and brother, did we fly
But the posse caught up with me, and he drag me back to Muskogee
And now it's two long years, waitin' around to die
